card.name: Spanish label imperative verbs
card.fires_on: Spanish imperative instructions on a drug label, at the start or middle of verbs like almacenar, mantenga, aplique, agite. Also the punctuation just before such a command.

modes.label: Storage commands
modes.description: Start of the Spanish verbs for storing or keeping the medicine away from children.
modes.example: Mantener el medicamento protegido del calor, luz y humedad,<< almacen>>ar a no más de 30

modes.label: Use instructions
modes.description: Period or verb start in Spanish directions for using a spray.
modes.example: Agite 10 veces antes de usarlo<<.>> Aplique directamente bajo la leng

modes.label: Cuídate-type slogans
modes.description: Spanish imperative in a health campaign slogan.

card.writes: It pushes toward polite command endings and the word please in several languages, such as -ite, -йте and 请.
card.plain: It lights up when a Spanish label is about to give an order, like store, keep or apply.
